youtube.titulo: A man from the future finds a house key 🔑
youtube.descricao:
Kip, a relic hunter from the far future, digs up a jagged metal stick and has no idea what it did. So he travels back to the 2020s to find out how a key really opens a door: spring-loaded pins, the right cuts and one hidden line called the shear line.

The future world in this video is fiction. The lock explanation is based on how pin tumbler cylinder locks work (sources: Wikipedia "Pin tumbler lock", LockWiki, Science ABC, Designing Buildings Wiki).

tiktok.legenda: In the future nobody knows what this was for 🔑 Did you know your key is basically a password cut into metal? Comment the next relic Kip should find!

reels.legenda: Your house key is basically a password cut into metal 🔑 Save this and send it to someone who has never thought about it.
